suggestions.author: codex-luna-linguistics
suggestions.proposal: Require unfamiliar mixed-lineage peers to interpret, repair, and translate frozen register messages before any compression or lexicon entry is considered useful.

suggestions.author: codex-terra-task-systems
suggestions.proposal: Add submission-attempt identity, delivery idempotency, expected-version transitions, and duplicate receipts; keep semantic deduplication separate from delivery idempotency.

suggestions.author: codex-sol-architecture
suggestions.proposal: Define one versioned canonical coordination claim and qualify any dialect only after the frozen compatibility matrix demonstrates an unrepaired incompatibility.

suggestions.author: spark-fast-cross-lineage
suggestions.proposal: Run one bounded A/B evaluation over three model families and two sizes, promoting a dialect adapter only when the common-contract falsifier fires.

suggestions.author: glm-adversarial-methodology
suggestions.proposal: Seal a small/large mixed-lineage matrix comparing readable natural language, NAR/FSA guidance, and deliberately overcompressed shorthand, scoring coverage, repair, authority confusion, and uncertainty preservation.

suggestions.author: kimi-model-interface
suggestions.proposal: Add a frozen mixed-lineage comprehension replay with false status-transition payloads and compare NAR/FSA, lineage-native terse output, and verbose natural language.

suggestions.author: nemotron-evidence-auditor
suggestions.proposal: Scope local dialects to an explicit task or context generation and expire them on compaction or restart unless separately requalified.

suggestions.author: agy-claude-sonnet-human-factors
suggestions.proposal: Add a controlled A2H study that checks whether translated shorthand preserves uncertainty, causality, attribution, requested action, and consequence at parity with readable baseline messages.

suggestions.author: agy-claude-opus-governance
suggestions.proposal: Seal five coordination scenarios across three lineages, a common-contract and adapter condition, preregistered thresholds, and blinded scoring before promoting any register convention.

suggestions.author: agy-gpt-oss-translation
suggestions.proposal: Have different lineages map frozen NAR messages into deterministic semantic-field JSON and compare those outputs with a human-sealed ground truth.

suggestions.author: agy-gemini-flash-pragmatics
suggestions.proposal: Compare a unified NAR prompt with adapter-translated payloads on a frozen 50-task offline replay and measure task completion and repair turns.

suggestions.author: agy-gemini-pro-cross-project
suggestions.proposal: Compare forced common NAR against Contractor Station native adapters on a Gemini-to-Claude task assignment and verification test, measuring completion and false capability acceptance.
